MARCH, 2015 TO ALL TO WHOM THESE PRESENTS shall come. GREETINGS: WHEREAS by Article 52 ( ) of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalamt it is provided that unless otherwise directed by His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan there shall be a sesslon of the Legislative Council once at least in every yearc so that a period of more than 12 months shall not intervene between the last sitting in one session and the date appointed fo r it s first sitting in the next sesslon. AND WHEREAS by Article 52 罔 of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalaml it is provided that each session of the Legislative Council shall be held at such place and shall commence and end at such time as His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan may from time to time, by notice published in the Gazette, appoint. N OW THEREFORE WE in exercise of the powers conferred upon US by the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam do hereby appoint the 14th. d ay of Jamadilawal , one thousand four hundred and thirty-six Hijriah corresponding to the 5th. d ay of March, two thousand and fifteen, to be the date for the commencement Of a session Of the Legislative Council to be held at the Dewan Persidangan Majlis Mesyuarat Negara , Dewan Majlis, Jalan Dewan Majlis, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam at 9 · oo 0'clock in the forenoon. Done at OUR lstana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam this llth. d ay of Jamadilawal , one thousand four hundred and thirty-six Hijriah corresponding to the 2nd. day of March, two thousand and fifteen, being the forty-eighth year of OUR Reign in Brunei Darussalam. 375
